title: 第2125章 突破异象第2124章 圣主
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：凡人修仙，谁能比我极阴更阴！第二卷：玄界第2125章突破异象（..la）时光如逝。
龙虚藤实力的提升，远比宋文预想中快。
仅仅两年不到，它那九阶后期的瓶颈，便如洪流冲击下的堤坝，轰然崩塌。
龙虚藤实力瞬间暴涨，晋升九阶巅峰。
若是人族修士、妖族精怪之流，突破这道瓶颈，必有天劫降临。
但龙虚藤的突破，却没多大动静。
许是因为龙虚藤乃是靠吸收炼化沌初炁胎而进阶，使得周遭源炁都没有出现大范围异常波动，仅有方圆百里的源炁汇聚而来。
以至于只有几头低阶虚妖和怨灵，发现了此间异常，前来查看，却被宋文神不知鬼不觉的给解决了。
龙虚藤依旧没有耗尽沌初炁胎的全部能量，仍然继续炼化，一鼓作气冲击仙境。
在龙虚藤进阶后的三个月，影虚那边也有了变化。
它那忽高忽低的气息，突然稳定下来，达到了九阶后期的圆满之境。
紧接着，影虚陡然苏醒，一双细长眼眸如闪电般睁开。
它也开始吸收天地间的源炁，助它冲击瓶颈。
......
转眼又是十年过去。
这日。
地下洞穴中的源炁，倏地如沸水般剧烈涌动。
“主人。”
龙虚藤银铃般的声音响起。
“我要进阶仙境了，只怕动静不会太小。”

宋文听出了它话中的担忧，开口道。
“你且放心突破。只要不是二阶仙境虚妖和怨灵前来，我皆可保你无虞。”
二阶仙境对应人族修士的实力，乃是玉霄玄仙。
宋文的手段，纵然克制虚妖和怨灵，却也不会自负到，能独自对付二阶仙境虚妖和怨灵的程度。
“多谢主人。”
龙虚藤说完，气息瞬间高涨。
地下洞穴上空的源炁，骤然受到某种牵引，形成一个通天彻地的巨大漩涡，牵扯着万里内的源炁，如百川归海般奔涌汇聚而来。
源炁漩涡顿时撕裂大地，直入地下洞穴。
龙虚藤疯狂的吞噬吸收这海量源炁。
可就在这时。
影虚身上也发生异变，其气息也突然暴涨，朝着仙境发起冲击。
那个源炁漩涡，顿时出现了两处‘风根’，分别没入影虚和龙虚藤体内。
这也导致，源炁漩涡越发庞大。周遭受到牵引的源炁，也越发辽阔。
宋文见此一幕，颇感无奈。
龙虚藤和影虚竟然同时冲击仙境，也不知是好是坏。
宋文早已撤去了隐匿阵法。
面对如此剧烈的源炁异动，隐匿阵法难以维继。
他已然退到了百里开外，神识紧盯着龙虚藤、影虚，以及四周的一切。
因此地源炁浩荡，宋文神识原本只能感知到里许之遥。但那巨型漩涡，将源炁给抽取了过去；使得天地间的源炁浓度、尤其是‘风根’附近的源炁浓度，急剧降低。
这倒是令宋文的神识感知范围大大提升，足以感知周遭数百里。

“主人，西面有怨灵靠过了。共七头，全是九阶的实力。”影虚的声音，突然在宋文脑中响起。
宋文的神识，顿时聚于西方。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Among mortals cultivating immortality, who can be more yin than me! Volume 2: Mysterious World Chapter 2125 Breakthrough Vision (..la) Time flies by.
The strength of Longxu Teng improved much faster than Song Wen expected.
In less than two years, its bottleneck at the late ninth level collapsed like a dam under the impact of a torrent.
The strength of Longxu Teng increased instantly, reaching the peak of ninth level.
If human monks, monsters, spirits and the like break through this bottleneck, disaster will surely come.
But Long Xuteng's breakthrough didn't make much difference.
Perhaps because the Dragon Void Vine advanced by absorbing and refining the embryonic energy of chaos, there was no large-scale abnormal fluctuations in the surrounding source energy, and only the source energy within a radius of a hundred miles gathered.
As a result, only a few low-level virtual demons and resentful spirits discovered the anomaly here and came to check, but Song Wen solved it without anyone noticing.
The Dragon Void Vine still hasn't exhausted all the energy of the Chaos Qi Embryo, and continues to refine it, attacking the fairyland in one go.
Three months after Longxu Teng advanced, Yingxu also had changes.
Its aura, which was rising and falling, suddenly stabilized, reaching the state of perfection at the late ninth level.
Immediately afterwards, Yingxu suddenly woke up, and a pair of slender eyes opened like lightning.
It also began to absorb the energy between heaven and earth, helping it break through the bottleneck.
...
In the blink of an eye, another ten years have passed.
This day.
The source of Qi in the underground cave suddenly surged violently like boiling water.
"Master."
The silver bell-like sound of Longxu Vine sounded.
"I'm going to advance to the fairyland, I'm afraid the movement won't be too small."
Song Wen heard the worry in its words and spoke.
"Don't worry about breaking through. As long as there are no second-level fairyland virtual demons and resentful spirits coming, I can keep you safe."
The second-level fairyland corresponds to the strength of the human monks, which is the Yuxiaoxuanxian.
Even though Song Wen's method can restrain virtual demons and resentful spirits, he is not so conceited that he can deal with second-level fairyland virtual demons and resentful spirits on his own.
"Thank you, Master."
After Longxuteng finished speaking, his aura suddenly became high.
The Yuan Qi above the underground cave was suddenly pulled by something, forming a huge whirlpool that stretched across the sky and the earth, pulling in the Yuan Qi from thousands of miles away, rushing together like hundreds of rivers returning to the sea.
The source energy vortex immediately tore through the earth and went straight into the underground cave.
Long Xuteng frantically swallowed and absorbed this massive amount of source energy.
But at this moment.
Changes also occurred in Yingxu's body, and his aura suddenly surged, attacking towards the fairyland.
That Source Qi vortex suddenly had two 'wind roots', which were submerged into the bodies of Yingxu and Longxu Teng respectively.
This also caused the Source Qi vortex to become larger and larger. The source of Qi that was being pulled around became wider and wider.
Seeing this scene, Song Wen felt helpless.
Longxu Teng and Yingxu actually attacked the fairyland at the same time, and I don't know whether it was good or bad.
Song Wen had already removed the concealment formation.
Faced with such a violent movement of source energy, the concealment formation was difficult to maintain.
He had already retreated a hundred miles away, his consciousness staring closely at Longxu Teng, Yingxu, and everything around him.
Therefore, the source of the earth was so powerful that Song Wen's spiritual consciousness could only perceive it a few miles away. But the giant whirlpool drew the source energy away, causing the source energy concentration between heaven and earth, especially the source energy concentration near the 'wind root', to drop sharply.
This greatly increased Song Wen's spiritual perception range, enough to sense hundreds of miles around him.
"Master, there are resentful spirits passing by to the west. There are seven of them in total, all with ninth-level strength." Yingxu's voice suddenly sounded in Song Wen's mind.
Song Wen's consciousness suddenly focused on the west.
